jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Bleiswijk
jobs.description: Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. A choice between weekly and four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Bleiswijk As a delivery driver, you are responsible for bringing Albert Heijn Online grocery orders from Bleiswijk to customers at home. At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. Once you are ready, you get into the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and carry the grocery crates to the front door. You greet the customer, hand over the order and provide friendly service. When necessary, you also collect empty crates to take back with you. You then continue to the next address on your route. The position offers a combination of independence and customer contact. While you spend part of your working day driving, you are also regularly on your feet. Walking, lifting grocery crates and getting in and out of the van are all part of the job. Once all orders have been delivered, you return to the location in Bleiswijk and complete your shift. Do I need experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous delivery or courier experience is not required. You will receive training when you start and can join an experienced colleague during your first working days. This allows you to learn the job before completing routes independently. What shifts are available? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do Ineed to work every Saturday? Not every Saturday. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement. Is this mainly a driving job? Driving is an important part of the position, but it is not the only task. You will regularly carry grocery crates, walk to customers' doors and get in and out of the delivery van. You therefore need to be comfortable with an active working day. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Bleiswijk You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Would you like to combine driving with an active job in Bleiswijk? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.
